_about: The data-source catalogue (PLAN-023 R1-8): one place for what the plugin knows about each outside source it reads, so the persona picker, the tests and later guards read the same facts. Fields: id (the id the persona files use), label, personas (the personas whose file lists the source; a test keeps it equal to the persona files), kind (file, API, STAC or feed), access (open, free key or licensed), credential (the Auth Manager name of the key when access is 'free key'), licence (what the tool or the provider states; 'see provider terms' where the code does not say), size_class (small, variable or large: variable means the size is only known from Content-Length at run time), size_guard (which existing guard asks first: content_length = check_download_size, whole_country_flag = allow_whole_country, extract_ask = local_data_loader.should_ask_before_download, or null), egress_class (what a request carries out of the machine: none = nothing about the user's request, area = a country code, place or bounding box, text = words the user or model wrote or text taken from a layer), egress_note, hosts (every host the code contacts), asset_hosts (hosts a file may be READ from after a search; only STAC uses it, and stac_ops.ALLOWED_HOSTS is built from it), cache_folder (under the project's data/00_raw, or null) and tools (registered tool names). Licensed or closed sources (HERE, TomTom, Google Places, AIS, commercial imagery, classified feeds) are not integrated and are not listed: the plugin takes a user-supplied file or key for them. Sources the persona files call 'not built' (Kobo/ODK, ACLED, CHIRPS, GTFS, DHIS2 ...) are added here only when they are built.

sources.label: Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX)
sources.licence: each HDX dataset states its own licence; the search tool ranks by it
sources.egress_note: the search words are sent to HDX

sources.label: geoBoundaries
sources.licence: each release states its own licence; see provider terms
sources.egress_note: a country code and admin level are sent

sources.label: OpenStreetMap (Overpass and Geofabrik extracts)
sources.egress_note: a bounding box and a feature key and value are sent to a public Overpass server

sources.label: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints
sources.licence: CDLA Permissive 2.0, as the tool states in its result
sources.egress_note: map tile keys covering the area are requested

sources.label: WorldPop population rasters
sources.egress_note: a country code and year are requested

sources.label: GDACS disaster alerts
sources.egress_note: the whole alert list is requested with fixed filters; nothing about the user's area is sent

sources.label: NASA EONET natural events
sources.licence: NASA open data; see provider terms
sources.egress_note: an optional bounding box, a category and a day count are sent

sources.label: NASA FIRMS active fires
sources.licence: NASA open data; a free MAP_KEY is required; see provider terms
sources.egress_note: a bounding box, a day count and the user's own MAP_KEY are sent

sources.label: OCHA Financial Tracking Service (FTS)
sources.egress_note: a country code or plan id is sent

sources.label: USGS earthquake catalogue
sources.egress_note: a bounding box and a time window are sent

sources.label: UCDP candidate georeferenced events
sources.licence: see provider terms (ucdp.uu.se); the tool says in every result that events are preliminary
sources.egress_note: a published file is downloaded and filtered on this machine; the JSON API needs a token and is not used

sources.label: Sentinel-2 imagery (Earth Search STAC)
sources.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data terms (free, full and open); see provider terms
sources.egress_note: a bounding box, a date range and a cloud limit are sent to the search; files are then read from the asset host

sources.label: Geocoding (OpenStreetMap Nominatim)
sources.licence: ODbL 1.0 (OpenStreetMap contributors); Nominatim has a usage policy
sources.egress_note: the place or address text is sent to a public server; for a batch the text comes from the layer's own fields, and a lookup is refused when the text comes from a protected (RESTRICTED or SENSITIVE) layer

sources.label: Web and news search
sources.licence: results keep their publishers' own terms
sources.egress_note: the search words are sent to DuckDuckGo, GDELT or Google News
